_comment: The one ApprovalPrep entity. src/lib/schema.ts (organizationNode, editorialAuthor) builds every Organization the site emits from this file; scripts/validate/schema-entity-graph.mjs asserts every built page matches it; scripts/ops/entity-backlink-watch.mjs (weekly, .github/workflows/entity-backlink-watch.yml) re-checks every profile and edits this file itself. sameAs lists only profiles that exist and resolve now. A profile not yet claimed goes in profiles_pending and is promoted by the watch once it resolves. Never list a profile on approvalprep.com itself. Never add a person here.
name: ApprovalPrep
description: Self-service letters, checklists and ready-to-apply packets for loan, rental and employment approvals.
